response.sql:
WITH site_counts AS (
  SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
), shares AS (
  SELECT zoneref, feature_count,
         feature_count::numeric / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share,
         1::numeric / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM site_counts
)
SELECT zoneref AS site_code,
       feature_count,
       share,
       share - average_share AS margin_above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > average_share
ORDER BY margin_above_average_share DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A site's feature count is the sum of its non-null traitcount values; the overall total and average share include only site codes with at least one non-null count. Shares and margins are returned as exact numeric ratios without rounding.
